Name: Adjustable Shed Price
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Allows you to adjust the price and materials required for the shed and big shed.

Allows you to make the cost of the shed super cheap or super expensive.  It's up to you. 

Two separate files for Android since it does not work with GMCM.  The two files are (1) double the vanilla price and materials for the shed and big shed and (2) half the vanilla price and materials for the shed and big shed . You can also manually modify the content file which avoids the need for GMCM.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Download the mod.  Extract into the same folder as other mods. 

[b]Requirements[/b]
Content Patcher
